{{dablink|For other uses of the word "lion," see [[Lion (disambiguation)]].}}
'''The Crown and Lion''' is an inn in [[Caemlyn]], located on the other side of the city from the [[Queen's Blessing]].

[[Rand al'Thor]] passed the inn during his wanderings around the city and gave it as his place of lodging when asked by [[Elaida]] so she would find it more difficult to locate him after his unplanned audience with Queen [[Morgase]].{{ref/book|1|40}}
